::: {#hello-block}
# Hi, I am Yu-En.

Just like the United Nations (UN)!

I build evaluation frameworks that track whether programs actually work over time. That means defining what success looks like, how to measure it, and what data to collect, then designing the systems and standards that capture it consistently year over year. 

I currently serve as the Evaluation Technical Lead at D'Aniello Institute for Veterans and Military Families (IVMF) at Syracuse University, working across workforce development and entrepreneurship programs for service members, veterans, and military families.
:::
